authoritySource: user-brief: energetic, bold, highly animated portfolio with accessibility and performance constraints
valueStatement: Motion gives Zade Studios its pulse: it assembles the entry, guides the work sequence, adds tactile feedback to links and keeps the final video chapter feeling like a handoff rather than a dead end.

reducedMotion.settledState: The intro keeps a static ZS mark, completed ring and readable status while the timed handoff uses a soft short panel transition; essential copy, links, project previews and CTA surfaces remain visible, video is replaced by poster fallback and transforms collapse.

mobileFallback.mode: Linear project stack, visible visit labels, no custom cursor, reduced orbital decoration and poster-capable contact media.

assetFailure: The contact section keeps a cobalt fallback color and poster image if lumen.mp4 cannot load; project SVGs remain local and independently addressable.
contextLoss: No canvas or WebGL context is used.
cleanup: Pointer and scroll listeners are passive and removed on unmount; rAF handles are cancelled on cleanup.

motionIntent.summary: Use one coherent signal language: a measured three-second ZS intro assembles the handoff, then a singular downward curtain reveals the page; scanline and marquee carry the hero rhythm, project tilt stays bounded and event-driven, buttons remain tactile, and the final video chapter feels like a handoff rather than a dead end.

signatureInteraction.name: ZS signal curtain
signatureInteraction.purpose: Turns the opening state into a brand-authored threshold and reveals the homepage with a confident downward handoff.
signatureInteraction.trigger: Initial page load; the progress ring completes over a fixed three-second intro before the overlay exits once.
signatureInteraction.settledState: The overlay is removed from hit testing and the normal homepage remains usable; the Visit project label stays available on focus and touch.

sectionRevealStrategy.initialState: Content is present in normal flow; the full-screen ZS overlay masks the first frame with a centered mark, status line and timed ring.
sectionRevealStrategy.trigger: The controlled intro timer reaches three seconds.
sectionRevealStrategy.transition: The dashed progress ring completes, then the overlay translates downward once as a single curtain with a restrained opacity settle; the settled state preserves the exited transform to prevent a reverse transition.
sectionRevealStrategy.settledState: Normal document content remains usable with or without animation.

sectionTransitionStrategy.strategy: Use color-block chapter handoffs: citrus hero to ink energy strip to paper work to cobalt studio to paper manifesto to video contact.
sectionTransitionStrategy.repeatOrStopRule: Continuous marquee/orbit stop under reduced motion; project tilt is event-driven and does not run continuously.
